data.name: Cabin Crew Life Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Roadmap


About the Game


Caution: This game is not recommended for those prone to airsickness!

Have you ever wondered what else flight attendants do besides serving tea and coffee? If you’re curious, step into Cabin Crew Life Simulator and find out!

Play as a stunning flight attendant and undergo intensive training to master every aspect of the job. From conducting safety checks and providing top-tier passenger service to coordinating with your crew and handling unexpected emergencies—you’ll experience it all!

FEATURES
Multiple airports and aircraft types:

You will work on various aircraft, from small to large, and at major airports across the world, spanning the globe. Get familiar with smaller aircraft before serving hundreds of passengers on double-decker planes.

Flight management:

As a cabin crew member, you will be responsible for ensuring the safety and satisfaction of passengers throughout the flight. Remember to keep the cabin clean and serve food and drinks to all passengers. You can assign tasks to fellow crew members to ensure every flight runs smoothly.

Emergency situations:

Handling emergency situations such as providing first aid to sick passengers, dealing with fires or explosions, or situations requiring emergency evacuation.

Engaging Gameplay:

Watch as passengers embark on your plane, tucking away their luggage for the journey ahead. Once everyone's settled, take the helm at your aircraft's control panel, located at the forefront of the cabin, where you can survey your upcoming tasks.

Earn and Upgrade:

Use your money or tip after each flight to purchase uniforms, beauty care cosmetics. It will help you increase attractiveness to the tycoons. You can also sell additional items on the flight to earn a living.

Advancing in your career:

The more flights you perform, the more experience you gain. When you reach a high level, you can recruit and train other flight attendants. Team up with them or remove them from the team if they do not meet the requirements.

Getting Started is Easy:

Don't forget to wear your uniform, receive the flight information on your tablet, navigate through security to your gate, tidy up the cabin before boarding passengers onto the aircraft, and prepare for takeoff!

Your Objective?

Perform your duties well on every flight, resist the temptations of money, become the world's number one flight attendant.

Embark on your flight attendant journey today and soar to new heights with Cabin Crew Life Simulator on Steam!

Let's find out with Cabin Crew Life Simulator, the pioneering flight attendant simulator with variety of aircraft, airports, passenger services, handling emergency situations, in-flight business, teamwork and much more.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit versions)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 4590
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1050
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit versions)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 2060, AMD Radeon RX Vega 56
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
